name: io.github.p7y-dev/p7y
title: Purgatory (p7y)
description: Self-hosted Docker sandboxes for agents: create one, deploy a compose stack, read its files and URLs

domain.description: The HOST_DOMAIN of your Purgatory server (its UI is at p7y.<domain>), e.g. example.com

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>: a Purgatory access token (Access tokens page); a token limited to one sandbox gets only that sandbox's tools
